name: application-inputs
title: Inputs
description: Form input components with responsive text fields, search boxes, and form controls. Customizable input elements with various styles including icons and floating labels.
useWhen: Form input components with responsive text fields, search boxes, and form controls. Customizable input elements with various styles including icons and floating labels.
avoidWhen: Avoid inputs when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Inputs uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
